digest.component_or_area: DET code-review criterion for wall-clock timing asserts in tests
propositions: Upper-bound wall-clock timing assertions in tests/** cause CI flakiness under runner contention and must be detected before merge via a blocking code-review criterion.
The detector must recognize two valid escapes: reasoned '# timing: hang-guard — <reason>' marker and skipif(CI) perf-lane guard; bare @pytest.mark.benchmark marker alone does not escape.

Two high-flake sites require migration to counting proxies: test_config_perf.py:201 spy on cfg._ordered_layers miss-path, and test_enrich_drain.py:261 count pending_enrichment calls with zero drain/spawn.
Remaining nine in-scope sites must carry reasoned hang-guard markers documenting timeout/shutdown/boot/reclaim justifications.
Detector unit tests must validate fire cases, both escapes, lower-bound exclusion, and self-exclusion via EXCLUDED_FILES idiom to prevent detector's own fixtures from triggering false positives.
